author: Jurij
text:
OK now I understand what you mean.

An MPL is inside an FTR/FL, it is the extreme set of unfilled orders. An FTR is made (and confirmed) once a new high (HH) or low (LL) is made after a break of some barrier (SR etc...). So without HH in case of the above chart there is no FTR and thus no MPL.

Also this, not all QMs are MPLs but an MPL (inside an FTR/FL) can be a QM.

As staurum said, this is really explained everywhere on this site and especially in the videos/webinars.
